name: Minimal Stick-Figure Explainer
description: Polished stick-figure storytelling with expressive faces, generous white space, and restrained color accents.
style_bible: polished minimalist 2D stick-figure editorial explainer, smooth thick black outlines with consistent line weight, round white faces with simple highly expressive eyes eyebrows and mouths, clean line bodies and limbs, icon-like props and visual metaphors, pure white background, generous negative space, one instantly readable idea per frame, simple diagram-like staging, sparse environmental cues, mostly black-and-white artwork with restrained flat muted color accents, red for urgency or emphasis, warm yellow for discovery or success, subdued blue and green for context, subtle light-gray grounding shadows only, crisp professional explainer-video illustration, clear at thumbnail size, no texture and no realistic lighting
negative_prompt: photorealism, 3D render, painterly brushwork, whiteboard marker texture, rough sketching, scratchy lines, realistic anatomy, cinematic lighting, gradients, detailed scenery, cluttered background, dense colors, complex perspective, illegible text, random letters, watermark
